TechnoCore Engineering (Pvt) Ltd is a Pakistan-incorporated engineering and technology contractor established in 2012, with offices in Islamabad (HQ), Lahore and Karachi, and a 250-person delivery team including PMP-certified project managers and PE-registered engineers. [CO-PROFILE] We combine ICT backbone design and cybersecurity with on-ground infrastructure execution—capabilities that align directly with CDA’s integrated scope covering city-wide fibre ducting/backbone, command-and-control data systems, and associated civil works.

For the Command & Control Centre and its data systems, we bring an ISO 27001-certified information security management system and delivered cybersecurity and cloud infrastructure deployments for government clients, providing a disciplined foundation for secure video management, storage and access control. [CO-PROFILE][CAP-001][CAP-049][CAP-024] For the network layer, we have executed network design deployments up to PKR 182M and 21 months, demonstrating structured design, integration and commissioning delivery. [CAP-009][CAP-021] On the civil side, our record includes road construction and bridge engineering deployments for federal/provincial and international clients, supporting CDA’s requirements for foundations, ducting corridors and works on live roads under a documented HSE policy with site safety plans. [CAP-003][CAP-015][CAP-027][CAP-028][CO-PROFILE]

We will submit the bid under PPRA Single Stage Two Envelope, and we can arrange the required bid security of PKR 44 million via CDR/bank guarantee within our available facility. [CO-PROFILE]

Mandatory eligibility gaps to address up-front:
- Our library does not yet evidence PEC constructor registration in category C-B or higher, ISO 14001 certification, PKR 2,500M average turnover, a PKR 1,500M safe-city project as prime, or assured access to trenching/boring/pole plant within 50 km of Islamabad. [CO-PROFILE]

Given CDA’s disqualification rule for mandatory gaps, we propose to meet these through a compliant JV/consortium with a PEC-registered civil/E&M constructor holding ISO 14001 and the required plant access, while TechnoCore leads secure ICT, fibre/network integration, and C2 cybersecurity governance under ISO 27001. [CO-PROFILE]
